conventions.unit_of_replication: One scenario-policy run with one seed; n = 5.
conventions.run_summary: Arithmetic mean and sample SD (denominator n - 1) of the five run metrics; each run has equal weight.
conventions.uncertainty: SD describes variation across these seeds. It is not a confidence interval, standard error, or significance test.
conventions.pairing: Within a scenario, policies share seed and arrival workload. Delta is policy minus role_fifo for the same seed.
conventions.gap_delta: A negative gap delta means smaller score differences.
conventions.wait_delta: A negative matched-wait delta can reflect selection of who completes. Interpret with match rate, observed queue residence, and pending ages.
conventions.pending_age_summary: Mean and oldest pending ages are summarized only over runs with pending players. No-pending runs have undefined pending age, although the source records mean pending age as zero.
conventions.pooled: Preserved separately from the source. Pooled means weight waits by matched-player count and gaps by team count. A mean of five run p95 values is not the pooled p95.
conventions.precision: Computed from recorded per-run summaries; source means are rounded to six decimal places. No unrecorded player-level observations are reconstructed.
conventions.observed_queue_time: Matched waiting times plus pending ages at second 319, divided by all arrivals; truncated queue residence time for every arrival, not an estimate of eventual completed wait.
conventions.claims: Descriptive synthetic experiment; no statistical-significance or population-generalization claims.

workload.schedule: At each integer tick enqueue all five arrivals, then exhaust all feasible teams; no arrivals after second 199.
workload.generator: SplitMix64 initialized with each seed; unbiased rejection sampling for bounded integers; Fisher-Yates shuffle exact role populations first, then generate scores in arrival order. Reinitialize the generator per scenario and seed.
